comments:
In the colophon, the author situates himself in the lineage stemming from Byang chub sems dpa' Zla ba rgyal mtshan (ID:6468).
The verses of homage in the incipit include reference to Nāgārjuna (ID:3720) and Candrakīrti (ID:3725), as well as the two Ku su lu (one o them might be Ratnasumati, Tib. Ku sa li che ba rin chen bzang) and Hasumati (ID:6180), "Bal po thang pa," "nyi" (for Pa tshab (ID:3868)) and "zla" (for Zla ba rgyal mtshan (ID:6468), and "mar me mdzad" (Atiśa, (ID:3745)) ex029022025-12-0411-13-02 .
